details.requestedScope: Close and reopen the extracted launcher with the same temporary profile and identical isolated loopback API port, without touching normal paths or services.
details.inspectionMethod: Read-only AST inspection of the launcher implementation and its existing argument definitions; original extracted-payload run reports retained as execution evidence.
details.freePortBehavior: Binds loopback port 0 to obtain an OS-assigned free port for every isolated launch; the socket is released before server startup.
details.reason: The existing isolated-profile option always calls free_port(). There is no API-port argument, environment override, or profile configuration override. Changing isolated-connection.json cannot force the server port: the launcher rewrites that connection with its newly selected port. The fixed 8765 branch requires normal mode, which selects normal data/client paths and is outside the permitted test scope.
details.whatWasVerifiedPreviously: Extracted native client first launch connected successfully; closing and reopening the same temporary profile retained one recipe and SQLite integrity. On the second launch a different random port was selected and the saved-URL guard prevented reconnection.
details.whatRemainsUnverified: Complete extracted launcher close/reopen with the same isolated API port, including service shutdown/restart and client reconnection. Normal fixed-port restart remains unvalidated; the previous random-port result is not a confirmed normal restart defect.
